stem.archstudio.template_browse: Explore a starting point. Choosing a template only changes this preview.
stem.archstudio.template_add_help: Add {count} blocks at X {x}, Y {y}, Z {z}. Side placements leave one empty cell between builds.
stem.archstudio.template_replace_help: Replace the current {count} blocks. Project name and notes stay the same. Undo restores the previous build.
stem.archstudio.template_preview_help: Drawings show occupied grid cells, not detailed curved or sloped shapes.
stem.archstudio.template_added: Added {count} template blocks. Undo restores the previous build.
stem.archstudio.template_replaced: Replaced the build with {count} template blocks. Undo restores the previous build.
stem.archstudio.template_bounds: This placement would leave the build area. Choose another side or replace the build.
stem.archstudio.template_capacity: The result would exceed 4,096 blocks. Remove blocks or choose a smaller template.
stem.archstudio.template_collision: The previewed position is now occupied. Review the updated placement before adding.
stem.archstudio.template_unchanged: The current build already matches this template.
stem.archstudio.template_replay: You can browse templates during replay. Return to the live build to apply one.
stem.archstudio.template_invalid: Choose an available template and placement.
stem.archstudio.template_desc_cottage: A stone base, wood walls, windows, and a pitched roof.
stem.archstudio.template_desc_temple: A marble platform with columns, arches, and a raised roof.
stem.archstudio.template_desc_tower: A tall stone tower with a doorway and battlements.
stem.archstudio.template_desc_bridge: A stone crossing with arch openings and metal railings.
stem.archstudio.template_desc_pyramid: Stepped stone layers with a marble cap.
